stories.headline: President Prabowo begins state visit to Japan, meets Emperor Naruhito and PM Takaichi
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto departed for Japan on March 29 for a three-day state visit, his first trip to Japan since taking office. He will meet Emperor Naruhito and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi to strengthen bilateral cooperation in trade, technology, education, forestry and environment.

stories.headline: Prabowo rejects $1 billion Board of Peace membership fee, clarifies Indonesia's role
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto clarified that Indonesia never pledged to pay $1 billion for Board of Peace membership and will only contribute 8,000 peacekeeping troops. He warned Indonesia may withdraw if the initiative proves counterproductive to Palestinian welfare.

stories.headline: TNI intelligence chief steps down following acid attack case involving personnel
stories.summary: Head of Strategic Intelligence Agency (BAIS) Lt. Gen. Yudi Abrimantyo resigned as a form of accountability after four BAIS personnel were implicated in an acid attack against human rights activist Andrie Yunus. TNI emphasized zero tolerance for violations and commitment to legal process.

stories.headline: Vice President Gibran visits Islamic boarding schools during Eid, emphasizes religious harmony
stories.summary: VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka visited multiple Islamic boarding schools during Eid celebrations in Central Java, meeting with religious leaders to emphasize the importance of religious harmony and social cohesion. He also discussed development programs and requested prayers for former President Jokowi's health.

stories.headline: Two Pertamina oil tankers remain stranded in Persian Gulf amid Hormuz Strait restrictions
stories.summary: Two Pertamina-owned oil tankers, Pertamina Pride and Gamsunoro, remain stuck in the Persian Gulf as Iran maintains tight restrictions on passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has given positive signals for eventual passage, with Indonesia and Iran discussing technical aspects of safe transit.

stories.headline: Prabowo orders cheap market at Monas and visits railway settlement residents
stories.summary: President Prabowo instructed officials to organize a cheap market at Monas providing 100,000 food packages worth Rp 50 billion to Jakarta residents. He also made an unannounced visit to railway settlement communities in Senen, engaging directly with residents about housing needs.

stories.headline: Prabowo meets investor Ray Dalio to discuss Danantara and economic growth prospects
stories.summary: President Prabowo received global investor Ray Dalio at Merdeka Palace to discuss strengthening Indonesia's economic growth and optimizing Danantara's role. The meeting focused on projections for economic development and Danantara's strategic role as a driver of national economic growth.

stories.summary: President Prabowo directed acceleration of mineral downstreaming and resource optimization, adding 13 new downstreaming projects valued at Rp 239 trillion. stories.headline: TNI conducts major leadership reshuffle with promotions and new appointments
stories.summary: TNI Commander General Agus Subiyanto led ceremony appointing new territorial chief Lt. Gen. Bambang Trisnohadi and conducting leadership transitions. stories.headline: Government implements work-from-home policy to reduce fuel consumption
stories.summary: Home Affairs Minister Tito Karnavian announced ministers agreed to implement one day per week work-from-home policy for civil servants to reduce fuel consumption amid rising oil prices. The policy awaits formal announcement after reporting to President Prabowo.
